subject.title: fix(ui): nudge stale tabs after gateway updates

question: After live evidence shows a stale Control UI tab reconnecting to an upgraded gateway, should this non-blocking refresh-banner UX be accepted for the Control UI?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the upgrade recovery experience and is protected by the `maintainer` label; automated tests establish lifecycle intent but not the actual browser/gateway behavior.

options.title: Request live upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted real gateway-upgrade/reconnect run shows the banner and user-triggered refresh without discarding composer state.

options.title: Sponsor with targeted acceptance review
options.body: A maintainer may accept the intended UX after independently reproducing the same-tab reconnect scenario on the current branch.

recommendation.title: Request live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted real gateway-upgrade/reconnect run shows the banner and user-triggered refresh without discarding composer state.

likelyOwner.reason: The author documented the intended reconnect lifecycle and can supply the missing real-behavior evidence for maintainer review.
